nom: Dior Dreamskin Care & Perfect - For a Skin-Perfecting, Filter Effect

avis.texte: I bought this very expensive serum expecting amazing results. I seem to be odd man out because i didn't notice anything. It is extremely fragrant and thats about it. Well not every product is great for everyone. I am 64 maybe it works better for younger skin.

avis.titre: A Staple In My Daily Skincare Routine
avis.texte: I thought my skincare routine was doing the trick before, but this has changed the game. I noticed improvements on day one, and my skin has only gotten better over the past few months since I started using it. Love it and will definitely buy again.

I absolutely love this product! I can instantly see improvement to my skin, it looks dewey and flawless! I also love the subtle scent. It is a little pricey, but it delivers resluts so it is worth it!

I'm 45 and I've been using this for about 10 years. I've tried nearly every other high end brand, this is the one that makes my skin soft and silky so I never go without it. The price is high and also it's worth it to me.
I Love using this product it covers my lites and gives me a healthy glow. Used other products and the finish is not as good as the Dreamskin.

You can definetely notice a glowing effect after a few days if use, but if you accidentally get it in your eyes its stings for HOURS. I love the effect it gives, but I find myself not using it just out if fear of hurting my eyes, and it REALLY hurts.

avis.titre: I would not buy this again
avis.texte: I am not a fan , I bought it hoping it would be a good product but it is the worst I have tried, I didn't finish the bottle and bought a different one , I am so disappointed especially for the price
It might work well but the small is so over bearing I had to wipe it off.

I saw the price and looked at cheaper options, but the reviews were so good, I thought I would buy it once and at least give it a try. Oh my goodness! Its amazing! I will never go without it again! My makeup and skin has never looked better!
amazing. 11/10. helped my cystic acne and calms skin, hydrates, AND blurs. LOVE this stuff

Dreamskin is PERFECT! I use it after skincare and before makeup but mostly without foundation. It just completes the day look without needing foundation (except for special occasions). Love this stuff!

avis.titre: My go-to for a flawless finish!
avis.texte: This is my second bottle of Dior Dreamskin Care & Perfect and I'll continue repurchasing in the future. Note: it is worth mentioning that this product is quite heavily fragranced. I personally love the fragrance as I find it very spa-like & relaxing. If you don't like/are sensitive to fragrance you may want to pass on this. This lightweight product is usually the last step in my skincare regimen as it leaves my skin ready for makeup. It seems to magically blur my pores and bring my skin to life. However, now that the summer heat & humidity have officially arrived I have little desire to suffocate my skin with makeup. During these hot summer months I often mix this Dreamskin Care & Perfect with some bronzing drops (currently using Pacifica Sunny Glow Bronzing Drops but have also used others like Drunk Elephant D-Bronzi, etc) to even out my skin & give it a natural looking, bronzed glow. This little combo gives me the absolute BEST no makeup makeup look & my skin can breathe! Sometimes, if I want a more matte look, I'll use a powder foundation over top. Regardless of how you choose to proceed with your makeup, this product will give you that beautiful, blurred, flawless airbrushed skin look. Highly recommend this Dior skin perfector!

If you are on tbe fence about buying this due to the price, please read. This serum is worth every penny. It will transform your skin into glowing radiance especially if you drink a lot of water. Not only does it smell heavenly, but it feels like actual silk in a creamy balm form. If I were a billionaire I would slather my entire body with this every single day. Yes, it is expensive — but the 1.7 oz bottle lasted me almost 3 months even with 2x daily application. Within just a few weeks' of consistent use of the serum, I noticed that I was getting SO many compliments on how good and healthy my skin looked. Even in my 30's I found myself struggling with cystic acne, texture unevenness, and skin discoloration. I felt very self-conscious about the way my skin looked without a full face of makeup. This serum cleared up my skin completely to the point where I don't feel the need to wear foundation every day and STILL get compliments on my skin! Buy it, buy it, BUY IT!!!!!!!
